sections.heading: Applied AI Engineer
sections.text: This role focuses on building practical AI agents, workflows, and automations to improve financial products and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to deploy reliable AI solutions that handle real-world constraints like latency, security, and compliance. The position requires hands-on engineering experience with LLMs, RAG systems, and production-grade software development. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of AI features, from identifying opportunities to maintaining them in production.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.text:
• Build AI agents, workflows, tools, and automations to solve customer and operational problems.
• Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, and guardrails to practical financial workflows.
• Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, KYC, risk review, and CRM.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to identify and build high-impact features.
• Design systems with a focus on accuracy, latency, cost, security, and compliance.

sections.heading: Required Skills:
sections.text:
• Python
• TypeScript
• JavaScript
• LLM application development
• RAG systems
• AI agent design
• Production-grade software engineering

sections.heading: Nice-to-Have Skills:
sections.text:
• Fintech experience
• Banking domain knowledge
• Support automation
• Fraud detection
• KYC/Risk management

sections.heading: About the Company
sections.text: Bjak is a leading Southeast Asian insurance and financial platform founded in 2019 with a mission to help people plan, save, and grow their money. The company operates globally with a diverse team and is currently expanding its services to include broader financial applications.

sections.heading: Editorial Analysis
sections.text:
The Job in a Nutshell:
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building and shipping AI features, requiring a blend of software engineering and applied AI skills, with an emphasis on accuracy, latency, cost, security, and compliance in a financial context.

sections.heading: Growth Opportunities
sections.text:
Skills You'll Develop:
You will gain deep expertise in AI-native product engineering and tackle complex, high-stakes technical challenges.

sections.heading: Application Guide
sections.text:
Optimize Your Resume:
Highlight your experience with LLMs, RAG, Python and TypeScript.

sections.heading: Remote Readiness Overview
sections.text:
Work From Home Perks
The role is fully remote, allowing for flexibility while requiring the candidate to be based in India to support the local market.

Not specified by the employer.
